response.rationale: The symmetric small-joint polyarthritis, prolonged morning stiffness, high-titer anti-CCP, positive RF, and MRI synovitis/tenosynovitis strongly support rheumatoid arthritis despite normal inflammatory markers.

rejected.why: Joint symptoms began 4 months before presentation, while COVID-19 occurred only 1 month before presentation, so the temporal relationship required for post-COVID reactive arthritis is absent.
ANA positivity is nonspecific here; negative ENA and dsDNA, absence of SLE clinical features, and the highly positive anti-CCP favor rheumatoid arthritis over systemic lupus erythematosus.
